claim_boundary: Phase52 validates deterministic histogram-to-physical-cost conversion and communication-only topology choice on the already-open Phase50 blind set
Phase52 is repeated engineering evidence, not a new target-isolated blind evaluation
teacher cost uses bin-average payloads and does not recover per-message cost inside each bin
results apply only to the exact Phase51 model layouts, frozen endpoint placements, RDMA path and measured payload support
no claim covers compute, memory, resource availability, queueing, congestion, overlap, online arrivals or end-to-end latency

convolution_contract.boundary_policy: clamp only to the measured model-specific minimum/maximum and audit every clamped bin and call; never extrapolate
convolution_contract.interpolation: piecewise linear over log2(payload_bytes), preserving unsmoothed Phase51 knots
convolution_contract.lower_curve: minimum of the two frozen placement-replica slower-direction knot values
convolution_contract.monotone_sensitivity_curve: cumulative maximum of unsmoothed official knots; diagnostic only and never replaces the official result
convolution_contract.official_curve: Phase51 slower direction then slower of two frozen placement replicas
convolution_contract.teacher_cost: the same deterministic bin-mean convolution applied to the frozen Phase50 Hfull histogram; it is not an exact per-message replay cost

fixed_scope.decision_scope: communication-only among the three frozen Phase51 topology candidates
fixed_scope.parallel_configuration: P TP=PP=1 and D TP=PP=1 remains a fixed input; Phase52 selects only topology/placement level

objective: 将Phase49冻结的六模型H0/H0+DNN预测和Phase50一次性打开的Hfull直方图，确定性卷积到Phase51六模型L1/L2/L3 Mooncake物理曲线，报告通信代价误差、communication-only placement agreement/regret及曲线方差敏感性

placement_contract.interval_robust_choice: selected upper/official cost <= every alternative lower-replica cost
placement_contract.monotone_stability: raw official selected/oracle topology equals the cumulative-max sensitivity selected/oracle topology
placement_contract.predicted_choice: minimum predicted official communication cost across L1/L2/L3 for one fixed profile/model/method
placement_contract.teacher_oracle: minimum frozen-Hfull official communication cost across the same candidates
placement_contract.teacher_regret: (teacher cost at predicted choice - teacher oracle cost) / teacher oracle cost
placement_contract.tie_break: L1 then L2 then L3 only for exact floating-point ties

pre_registered_scientific_questions.cost: does H0+DNN strictly reduce overall physical-cost WAPE and MAPE versus H0 on each of L1/L2/L3?
pre_registered_scientific_questions.placement: does H0+DNN weakly improve overall agreement and mean teacher regret versus H0?
pre_registered_scientific_questions.reporting_rule: execution PASS is independent of whether these already-frozen scientific hypotheses are confirmed; no retuning follows
pre_registered_scientific_questions.sensitivity: are predicted and oracle choices stable under the monotone curve diagnostic, and are interval-robust decisions distinguishable from overlapping placement curves?

stop_and_block_if: R51 is not the unique workflow parent or Phase50/51 pins and manifests fail
prediction/target keys, model roster, 12-bin vectors or curve matrix differ
any input prediction, Hfull label or physical curve would be changed or recomputed
execution would use GPU, network, model weights, checkpoint, raw trace or protected data
the scheduler is allowed to select TP/PP/P/D sizes or any non-communication resource decision
